items.t: Tripadvisor Loan Soars as $600 Million Payment Boosts Confidence
items.sum: Tripadvisor Inc.’s loan soared Monday as the company repaid $600 million of debt using proceeds of a sale, easing concerns for lenders as it faces a major leadership change and challenges from generative artificial intelligence tools.

items.t: Tripadvisor Announces Voluntary $600 Million Prepayment of Term Loan B Facility
items.sum: Tripadvisor, Inc. (NASDAQ: TRIP) today announced that the company has pre-paid $600 million of its Term Loan B Facility maturing July 8, 2031 ("Term Loan B"). The prepayment is consistent with management's stated intention to prioritize the reduction of long-term debt to preserve balance sheet strength, reduce interest expense, and maintain strong liquidity.
